title: Client
description: Represents a client who owns one or more sites and contracts cleaning services.

name.description: The name of the client (individual or company).

contactEmail.description: The primary email address of the client.

contactPhone.description: The primary phone number of the client.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the client was created (Firestore Timestamp).

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the client was last updated (Firestore Timestamp).
